facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para o que acontece agora e am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: I’m studying music. I’m going to play in a band.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m looking for Room 12. The teacher is at the door. Use também now e today para marcar o momento.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para falar de planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to be a doctor. We’re going to have History. Depois de going to, o verbo fica na forma básica.

pages.title: A big university · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning at a big university in Sydney. Hundreds of students walk across the green yard. Theo holds a map and a new notebook. He looks at the signs on the walls. A girl with a backpack stops near him. Her name is Uma.
“Hi, Theo! Are you looking for a classroom?” says Vera. “Yes, I’m looking for Room 12. It’s my first class.” says Leo. “I’m going there too. We’re going to have History.” says Vera.
